latest_semantic_finding.observation: The inspected BaseClient stores base_url as an httpx URL and _prepare_url merges relative request paths onto that base_url. SyncAPIClient is typed as BaseClient[httpx.Client, Stream[Any]] with _client: httpx.Client. Its request execution path calls self._client.send(request, ...), and the asynchronous path calls await self._client.send(request, ...). The same file defines the default synchronous client as an httpx.Client subclass and exposes an aiohttp-backed alternative through HTTP-client adapter plumbing.
latest_semantic_finding.inference: For this exact SDK base-client artifact, ordinary Groq SDK execution is network/request-client oriented: requests are built against base_url and dispatched through an HTTP client rather than executing model inference inside the SDK base client. No model-inference implementation or direct non-request execution path was identified in the inspected file. This materially strengthens the residual hidden-executor finding from p1-sa-426. However, because the SDK accepts a caller-supplied HTTP client, this file alone does not rule out an in-process custom/mock transport that replays prepackaged responses without an external endpoint.
